objects.query: SELECT Id, Name, SellingModelType FROM ProductSellingModel WHERE Name IN ('One-Time', 'Evergreen Annual', 'Term Annual', 'Term Based - Quarterly') ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT Id, StockKeepingUnit FROM Product2 WHERE StockKeepingUnit LIKE '5%' OR StockKeepingUnit LIKE '6%' ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT Description, Id, IsActive, IsStandard, Name FROM Pricebook2 WHERE Name IN ('Standard Price Book', 'EuroZone Price List', 'USA Price List') ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT CurrencyIsoCode, Id, IsActive, IsDerived, Pricebook2Id, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, UnitPrice, UseStandardPrice, Pricebook2.Name, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM PricebookEntry WHERE Pricebook2.IsStandard = true AND (Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE '5%' OR Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE '6%') ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode ASC
SELECT Code, Id FROM AttributeDefinition WHERE Code IN ('DS_LICENSE_COMMITMENT', 'DS_SUBSCRIPTION_COMMITMENT') ORDER BY Code ASC

SELECT AdjustmentMethod, CurrencyIsoCode, Description, EffectiveFrom, Id, IsActive, Name, Pricebook2Id, ScheduleType, Pricebook2.Name FROM PriceAdjustmentSchedule WHERE Name LIKE 'DS %' ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT Id, Name FROM AttributeBasedAdjRule WHERE Name LIKE 'DS %' ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT AttributeBasedAdjRuleId, AttributeDefinitionId, Id, Name, Operator, ProductId, StringValue, AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name, AttributeDefinition.Code, Product.StockKeepingUnit FROM AttributeAdjustmentCondition WHERE AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name LIKE 'DS %' ORDER BY AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name ASC

SELECT AdjustmentType, AdjustmentValue, AttributeBasedAdjRuleId, CurrencyIsoCode, EffectiveFrom, Id, Name, PriceAdjustmentScheduleId, ProductId, ProductSellingModelId, AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name, PriceAdjustmentSchedule.Name, Product.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM AttributeBasedAdjustment WHERE AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name LIKE 'DS %' ORDER BY AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode ASC
SELECT Id, Name, SellingModelType FROM ProductSellingModel WHERE Name IN ('One-Time', 'Evergreen Annual', 'Term Annual', 'Term Based - Quarterly') ORDER BY Name ASC
SELECT Id, StockKeepingUnit FROM Product2 WHERE StockKeepingUnit LIKE '5%' OR StockKeepingUnit LIKE '6%' ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC
SELECT Id, IsStandard, Name FROM Pricebook2 WHERE Name IN ('Standard Price Book', 'EuroZone Price List', 'USA Price List') ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT CurrencyIsoCode, Id, IsActive, IsDerived, Pricebook2Id, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, UnitPrice, UseStandardPrice, Pricebook2.Name, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM PricebookEntry WHERE Pricebook2.IsStandard = false AND Pricebook2.Name IN ('EuroZone Price List', 'USA Price List') AND (Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE '5%' OR Product2.StockKeepingUnit LIKE '6%') ORDER BY Pricebook2.Name ASC, Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode ASC
